verdict.rationale: Linear supports creating docs from team home pages, adding existing documents to projects/issues, and grouping resources into sections, plus AI Loops that keep docs and project descriptions updated — directly supporting shared docs organized alongside project work. However, evidence is limited to a single changelog mention with no detail on document structure, hierarchy, permissions, or search/organization depth. Missing for 10: detailed docs on nested/organized doc hierarchies, collaborative editing features, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor changelog snippets.
